description: Head-movement mini-game GA18, opening Group D: guess-the-direction game. The secret direction (5 fixed rounds: left, down, right, up, right) is never shown or named; TTS only reports distance bands (far / close / very near / near, hold steady) from the sensor-derived head direction, and holding steady 0.8 s within 12 deg finds the round. 20 s timeout is a miss; return to center gates every next round. Dual-axis start calibration (look down, turn left) learns both signs. Temple tap starts and replays; no camera, no mic/ASR.
name: guess-direction
